summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Admin Forms Management feature. All 15 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing verified: Admin Forms page at /admin/forms with full CRUD capabilities, and Workspace Forms tab with user-only access (fill forms + view submissions, no template management).
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/admin/form-templates - Returns all templates across workspaces with workspace_name enriched
Backend: GET /api/admin/workspaces-list - Returns workspaces for dropdown selection
Backend: POST /api/admin/form-templates?workspace_id=X - Create template with recipient_emails
Backend: PUT /api/admin/form-templates/{id} - Update template including recipient_emails
Backend: PUT /api/admin/form-templates/{id} - Returns 404 for non-existent template
Backend: DELETE /api/admin/form-templates/{id} - Delete template and its submissions
Backend: DELETE /api/admin/form-templates/{id} - Returns 404 for non-existent template
Backend: GET /api/admin/form-submissions - Get all submissions across workspaces
Backend: GET /api/admin/form-submissions?template_id=X - Filter submissions by template
Backend: DELETE /api/admin/form-submissions/{id} - Delete any submission
Backend: DELETE /api/admin/form-submissions/{id} - Returns 404 for non-existent submission
Backend: GET /api/workspaces/{id}/form-templates - User can view templates
Backend: POST /api/workspaces/{id}/form-submissions - User can submit forms
Backend: GET /api/workspaces/{id}/form-submissions - User can view own submissions
Frontend: Admin sidebar shows 'Forms' link that navigates to /admin/forms
Frontend: Admin Forms page shows 'Form Templates' title with template count
Frontend: Admin Forms page has '+ New Template' button with data-testid
Frontend: Admin Forms table shows columns: Template Name, Workspace, Fields, Recipients, Status, Created, Actions
Frontend: Admin Forms table shows recipient email badges for templates with recipients
Frontend: Admin Forms table shows Edit, Delete, and View Submissions buttons for each template
Frontend: Admin Form Builder has Form Name input, Description textarea, Workspace selector, Recipient Emails input
Frontend: Admin Form Builder has all 6 field type buttons (Text Input, Text Area, Date, Number, Yes/No, Dropdown)
Frontend: Admin Submissions view shows table with Submitted By, Email, Date, Responses, Actions columns
Frontend: Workspace Forms tab shows form templates with 'Fill Out' and 'My Submissions' buttons only
Frontend: Workspace Forms tab does NOT show 'New Template' button (correct for user view)
Frontend: Workspace Forms tab does NOT show Edit or Delete template buttons (correct for user view)
Frontend: Workspace Fill Form view shows submitter info and form fields with Submit button
Frontend: Workspace My Submissions view shows user's own submissions with View button
seed_data_creation: Test templates created and cleaned up during backend testing. Existing templates: 2 Maintenance Request Forms (one in ICT Support workspace with recipient_emails set, one in My First Workspace without recipients).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin Forms Management feature is fully functional. Admin page at /admin/forms provides full CRUD for form templates across all workspaces with recipient_emails support. Workspace Forms tab at /workspace/{id}/manage (Forms tab) allows users to fill forms and view their own submissions only - no template management buttons visible. Backend routes: admin_router at /api/admin/form-templates, /api/admin/form-submissions, /api/admin/workspaces-list. Workspace routes at /api/workspaces/{id}/form-templates and /api/workspaces/{id}/form-submissions. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_admin_forms.py
